question: In May 2023 _________ Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India has been re-elected as the external auditor of the World Health Organization (WHO) for a 4-year term from 2024 to 2027.
solution:
The correct answer is __**G. C. Murmu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **G. C. Murmu**, the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India, has been re-elected as the external auditor of the World Health Organization (WHO).
 
• His new term will span **4 years**, starting from 2024 and ending in 2027.
 
• The re-election of G. C. Murmu is a recognition of the **high standards** and **professionalism** maintained by the Indian audit institution.
 
• The role of the external auditor involves providing independent assurance on the financial statements and operations of the WHO.
 
• This re-election underscores India's growing influence and credibility in global financial governance and auditing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India** is an authority established by the Constitution of India under Chapter V, who audits all receipts and expenditure of the Government of India and the state governments, including those of bodies and authorities substantially financed by the government.
 
• The CAG is also the external auditor of the **United Nations** and its agencies, and the **World Health Organization (WHO)** is one of the specialized agencies of the UN.
 
• The CAG's role in international organizations helps in enhancing the accountability and transparency of these institutions.
 
• G. C. Murmu assumed office as the CAG of India on **8th August 2020**.
 
• He has previously served as the **Lieutenant Governor of the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir**.
